risk_if_not_implemented: Without Materiality Determination, security, compliance and resilience activities may lack direction, ownership and executive support, leaving required controls unperformed. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Regulatory / Legal / Contractual Financial Liability (R-EX-5), Unreliable Assurance / Decision Information (R-GV-10), Delayed Containment / Increased Incident Impact (R-IR-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Statutory / Regulatory / Contractual Change (MT-11).

compensating_control_1.name: Risk Ranking
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to identify and assign a risk ranking to newly discovered security vulnerabilities that is based on industry-recognized practices.
compensating_control_1.justification: Risk Ranking (RSK-15) provides risk identification and prioritization that compensates for the absence of Materiality Determination (GOV-07) by enabling informed decisions about where to focus resources to manage residual exposure. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Executive Leadership Oversight of Security, Compliance & Resilience Controls
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to provide a security, compliance and resilience controls oversight function that reports to the organization's executive leadership.
compensating_control_2.justification: Executive Leadership Oversight of Security, Compliance & Resilience Controls (CPL-07) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Materiality Determination (GOV-07) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
